anthropic.freeTierDetails: No free tier. Pay-as-you-go from $0.25/M tokens (Haiku).
anthropic.paidTierDetails: Pro: $20/mo for 5x limits. Team: $25/user/mo. Enterprise: custom.
anthropic.usageTracking: Dashboard shows token usage by model, date, project. Export CSV available.
anthropic.costEstimation: Use token counting API: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens. ~4 chars = 1 token.

google.freeTierDetails: Generous free tier: 15 RPM, 1M tokens/day for Gemini 1.5 Flash. 1.5 Pro: 2 RPM free.
google.paidTierDetails: Pay-as-you-go: Flash $0.075/M in, $0.30/M out. Pro: $1.25/M in, $5/M out.
google.usageTracking: Cloud Console shows API calls, tokens, latency. Budgets and alerts configurable.
google.costEstimation: Use countTokens() method. Context caching available for 75% discount on repeated content.

groq.freeTierDetails: Free tier: 14,400 req/day, 30 RPM. Access to all models including Llama 3.1 70B.
groq.paidTierDetails: On-demand: $0.05-0.79/M tokens. Enterprise: dedicated instances, SLA, custom models.
groq.usageTracking: Dashboard: requests, tokens, latency per model. Real-time rate limit status.
groq.costEstimation: Very low cost. 70B: $0.59/M in, $0.79/M out. 8B: $0.05/M in, $0.08/M out.

openrouter.freeTierDetails: Free tier: $1 credit on signup. Access to free models (various).
openrouter.paidTierDetails: Pay-as-you-go at provider rates + small routing fee. Credits purchased in advance.
openrouter.usageTracking: Dashboard: spend by model, provider, date. Per-request cost breakdown.
openrouter.costEstimation: Shows exact cost per request. Auto-router optimizes for cost/quality.

cline.freeTierDetails: ClinePass free: 50 requests/day. Local models (Ollama) completely free.
cline.paidTierDetails: ClinePass Pro: $20/mo for unlimited cloud requests. Team: custom pricing.
cline.usageTracking: VS Code status bar shows daily usage. Detailed logs in output channel.
cline.costEstimation: Cloud requests use provider pricing. Local models: $0. Credits deducted per request.

opencode.freeTierDetails: Open source: self-host completely free. Zen Cloud: free tier with limits.
opencode.paidTierDetails: Zen Cloud Pro: $30/mo. Enterprise: self-hosted with support contracts.
opencode.usageTracking: Self-hosted: your infrastructure. Cloud: dashboard with usage metrics.
opencode.costEstimation: Self-hosted: only infrastructure costs. Cloud: per-seat or usage-based.

nvidia.freeTierDetails: NIM evaluation: 30-day trial. NGC catalog has free containers for development.
nvidia.paidTierDetails: NIM Enterprise: per-GPU subscription. Cloud: pay-per-use on DGX Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP.
nvidia.usageTracking: NGC dashboard for container usage. Cloud provider billing for managed services.
nvidia.costEstimation: Depends on deployment: self-hosted (GPU costs) or managed (per-request).
